prompt: C#: clamp health to zero through max.
target: static int ClampHealth(int health, int max) => Math.Clamp(health, 0, max);

prompt: C#: apply nonnegative damage; health cannot go below zero.
target: static int ApplyDamage(int health, int damage) => Math.Max(0, health - Math.Max(0, damage));

prompt: C#: heal health without exceeding max.
target: static int Heal(int health, int amount, int max) => Math.Clamp(health + Math.Max(0, amount), 0, max);

prompt: C#: reduce a cooldown by delta, floor at zero.
target: static float TickCooldown(float time, float delta) => Math.Max(0f, time - Math.Max(0f, delta));

prompt: C#: return whether health is above zero.
C#: add points but ignore negative awards.
target: static int AwardScore(int score, int points) => score + Math.Max(0, points);

prompt: C#: spend stamina only when cost is affordable.
target: static bool TrySpend(int current, int cost, out int remaining) { remaining = current; if (cost < 0 || current < cost) return false; remaining = current - cost; return true; }

prompt: Godot C#: limit a Vector2 input to unit length.
target: static Vector2 SafeDirection(Vector2 input) => input.LengthSquared() > 1f ? input.Normalized() : input;

prompt: Godot C#: move a Vector2 toward target by speed times delta.
target: static Vector2 StepToward(Vector2 current, Vector2 target, float speed, float delta) => current.MoveToward(target, speed * delta);

prompt: Godot C#: test whether two Vector2 positions are within range.
target: static bool InRange(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, float range) => a.DistanceSquaredTo(b) <= range * range;

prompt: C#: wrap an index, including negative values, for positive count.
target: static int WrapIndex(int index, int count) => ((index % count) + count) % count;

prompt: C#: calculate coin reward with a nonnegative multiplier.
target: static int CoinReward(int coins, int multiplier) => Math.Max(0, coins) * Math.Max(0, multiplier);

prompt: C#: clamp linear audio volume between zero and one.
C#: remove one life without going below zero.
target: static int LoseLife(int lives) => Math.Max(0, lives - 1);

prompt: C#: report whether a cooldown is ready.
C#: check currency can cover a nonnegative cost.
target: static bool CanAfford(int currency, int cost) => cost >= 0 && currency >= cost;
